releaseNotes: 修复 v0.6.2 安装盘在已有同名 QuitHide 磁盘映像挂载时可能丢失拖拽安装提示的问题。发布构建现在会阻止同名卷冲突，并在打包和公证后验证 Finder 布局、背景图与 Applications 链接，避免不完整安装盘再次发布。App 功能未发生变化。
releaseNotesEn: Fixes an issue where the v0.6.2 disk image could lose its drag-to-Applications guidance when another QuitHide disk image with the same volume name was already mounted. Release builds now block same-name volume conflicts and verify the Finder layout, background, and Applications link after packaging and notarization. App functionality is unchanged.
